title: AWS coverage ledger decisions
description: The reviewed decisions the ledger joins with its derived facts (specs/spec-aws-core-coverage-ledger.md). Every entry carries a reason a later reader can check.

service_map.description: A CloudFormation service name to the botocore services it means, where the names do not say.

type_map.description: Each aws_core entity type to the CloudFormation type(s) it models, or the reason it has none.

classification.description: A CloudFormation type to excluded (not a node) or not-enumerable (may be a node, no in-scope source enumerates it), with the written reason.

service_classification.description: A botocore service with no CloudFormation type, to excluded (no resources to model) or not-enumerable, with the written reason. A service with CloudFormation types is classified through those rows.

tag_findings.description: A CloudFormation type to a tag finding that settles what the schema leaves open or gets wrong: whether the type has tags, with the citation that shows it. A finding is the only way a type's tags are confirmed beyond the CloudFormation schema, and the only way a `not-found` or `conflict` row is settled. The citation names a service operation or a documentation page, not a search.
